name: gavana-rules-test
description: Firestore + Storage security-rules tests on the emulators. Own dependencies so the app's firebase version is never touched.

scripts.test: cd ../.. && scripts/rules-test/node_modules/.bin/firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.rules-test.json --only firestore,storage --project demo-gavana "node scripts/rules-test/rules.test.mjs && node scripts/rules-test/storage.test.mjs"
